_comment: Operator corrections for the Hilmar tracker. Authoritative human overrides, applied by ingest.apply_operator_corrections() AFTER all automatic classification and on EVERY run, so a verdict survives re-ingest (which otherwise rebuilds the row from the staged email and re-promotes it). qc_selfheal imports and re-applies the same function as a self-heal backstop. Add an entry when an operator (OL ops / Lonny / Michael) authoritatively corrects a row the pipeline classified wrong; match by request_id; `set` lists the fields to overwrite.

AgriDairy booking, not a Hilmar-the-client move. The 'HILMAR' token in the booking is the plant/origin reference, not the customer -- only moves booked by Lonny are Hilmar the client. Same Hilmar-as-supplier class as the Numidia leak; 'agridairy' is now an out_of_scope_reason marker so future ones are dropped at intake.

MDOLX261072 booked (ONE, booking RICGBS913900) — Oakland to Cai Mep. Source: OL operational booking recap sent by Linda Echevarria 2026-08-12. TWO JUDGEMENTS RECORDED HERE, both Michael's to overturn: (1) OL booked CAI MEP while Lonny's ask names CAT LAI — different HCMC terminals, so the automatic matcher refused it on core.same_port, which is the rule that keeps Manila North off Manila South; Michael: 'everything she sent as a booking is a win... each was clearly a request'. (2) Two Cat Lai asks were open (Aug 11 and Aug 12); this takes the OLDER one, leaving the same-morning Aug 12 ask free for its own booking. Flip the request_id if that is backwards.

MDOLX261071 booked 2026-08-12. Source: OL operational booking recap sent by Linda Echevarria 2026-08-12. Michael: 'everything she sent as a booking is a win... assume that each win was a quote request so just use the wins if you cannot find the emails from lonny'. No confirmation email for this MDOLX exists in the tracked mailbox (diag_find, 2026-08-12) and OL's own row carries NO POD, carrier or booking number — so the lane is left unresolved rather than guessed. Supply the lane and this row gains it; if the real confirmation ever arrives, ingest's own row takes precedence and this one stands down automatically.
